intro_en: You will learn how to describe an earthquake and what to do during and after the tremor, and how to narrate sudden interruptions with -х гэж байтал in Mongolian and 'was about to... when' in English.
intro_mn: Та газар хөдлөлтийг тайлбарлах, доргилтын үеэр болон дараа юу хийхээ хэлэх, мөн гэнэтийн үйл явдлыг монголоор -х гэж байтал, англиар 'was about to... when' бүтцээр өгүүлэхийг сурна.

vocab.example_mn: Өчигдөр шөнө Улаанбаатарт газар хөдлөлт болсон.
vocab.example_en: An earthquake happened in Ulaanbaatar last night.
Suddenly there was a loud noise.
The tremor lasted only a few seconds.

vocab.example_mn: Оршин суугчдыг гэр хорооллоос нүүлгэн шилжүүлсэн.
vocab.example_en: The residents were evacuated from the ger district.

vocab.example_mn: Нурсан байшингийн нуранги дундаас хүмүүсийг хайсан.
vocab.example_en: They searched for people in the rubble of the collapsed building.

vocab.example_mn: Доргилтын үеэр цахилгаан шатаар бүү яв, шатаар бууж гар.
vocab.example_en: During a tremor, don't take the elevator; go down the stairs.

vocab.example_mn: Бид задгай талбай руу, аюулгүй газар гарлаа.
vocab.example_en: We went out to an open square, a safe place.

vocab.example_mn: Давтан доргилт болж магадгүй тул болгоомжтой байгаарай.
vocab.example_en: Aftershocks may occur, so be careful.

sentences.mn: Би гарах гэж байтал газар хөдөлж эхэлсэн.
sentences.en: I was about to leave when the ground started to shake.
alt_en: I was just about to go out when the ground began shaking.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi garakh gej baital gazar khödölj ekhelsen.

sentences.mn: Бид оройн хоол идэх гэж байтал хүчтэй доргилт болов.
sentences.en: We were about to eat dinner when a strong tremor hit.
alt_en: We were just about to have dinner when a strong tremor struck.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid oroin khool idekh gej baital khüchtei dorgilt bolov.

sentences.mn: Хүүхдээ унтуулах гэж байтал гэнэт чимээ гарлаа.
sentences.en: I was about to put my child to sleep when I suddenly heard a noise.
alt_en: I was just about to put my child to bed when there was a sudden noise.
sentences.mn_latin: Khüükhdee untuulakh gej baital genet chimee garlaa.

sentences.en: During the tremor, take cover under a table.
alt_en: During the tremor, hide under a table.

sentences.en: Stay away from windows and glass.
alt_en: Keep away from windows and glass.

sentences.mn: Доргилт зогсмогц бид шатаар бууж гарсан.
sentences.en: As soon as the tremor stopped, we went down the stairs.
alt_en: Once the shaking stopped, we walked down the stairs.
sentences.mn_latin: Dorgilt zogsmogts bid shataar buuj garsan.

sentences.en: You must not use the elevator.
The people in our building were evacuated.
alt_en: The residents of our building were evacuated.

sentences.en: A large crack has appeared in the wall.
alt_en: There is a big crack in the wall.

sentences.mn: Дахин доргилт болох вий гэж айж байлаа.
sentences.en: I was afraid that another aftershock might come.
alt_en: I was worried there might be another aftershock.
sentences.mn_latin: Dakhin dorgilt bolokh vii gej aij bailaa.

sentences.mn: Бид задгай талбайд очоод хөршүүдээ тоолсон.
sentences.en: We went to an open square and counted our neighbors.
alt_en: We went to an open area and checked that all our neighbors were there.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid zadgai talbaid ochood khörshüüdee toolson.

sentences.en: I turned off the gas and went outside.
alt_en: I shut off the gas and went out.

grammar.explain_en: Use a verb in its -х form + гэж байтал to say 'I was just about to do X, when suddenly Y happened.' The first part shows an action that was about to start. The second clause, usually in the past, is the interruption. Example: Гарах гэж байтал утас дуугарав. = I was about to leave when the phone rang. The part гэж байтал never changes. Only the verb takes its -х form, with the vowel before -х following vowel harmony (гарах, идэх, орох, өгөх).
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд 'was/were about to + үйл үг, when ...' бүтцээр хийх гэж байсан үйлдлийг гэнэт таслагдсан байдлаар өгүүлнэ. Жишээ: I was about to leave when the phone rang. = Би гарах гэж байтал утас дуугарав. 'was about to' нь өнгөрсөн цагт хэрэглэгдэх ба таслагдсан үйл явдлыг 'when'-ээр эхэлсэн өгүүлбэр илэрхийлнэ.

examples.mn: Би унтах гэж байтал газар хөдөлсөн.
examples.en: I was about to go to sleep when the ground shook.
examples.mn_latin: Bi untakh gej baital gazar khödölsön.

examples.mn: Бид гарах гэж байтал цахилгаан тасарлаа.
examples.en: We were about to go out when the power went off.
examples.mn_latin: Bid garakh gej baital tsakhilgaan tasarlaa.

examples.mn: Тэр утасдах гэж байтал чимээ гарав.
examples.en: She was about to make a call when there was a noise.
examples.mn_latin: Ter utasdakh gej baital chimee garav.

examples.mn: Багш хичээл эхлэх гэж байтал доргилт болов.
examples.en: The teacher was about to start the lesson when a tremor hit.
examples.mn_latin: Bagsh khicheel ekhlekh gej baital dorgilt bolov.

fill_blank.text: Би орондоо орох гэж ___ газар хөдөлсөн.
fill_blank.translation: I was about to get into bed when the ground shook.
fill_blank.explain_en: The pattern -х гэж байтал expresses 'was about to... when'.
fill_blank.explain_mn: '-х гэж байтал' нь 'хийх гэж байхад гэнэт' гэсэн утгатай.

fill_blank.translation: As soon as the tremor stopped, we went down the stairs.
fill_blank.explain_en: Бууж гарах means to go down and out; we leave the building by the stairs.

fill_blank.text: Оршин суугчдыг аюулгүй газар руу ___ шилжүүлсэн.
fill_blank.translation: The residents were evacuated to a safe place.
fill_blank.explain_en: Нүүлгэн шилжүүлэх is the fixed verb phrase for 'to evacuate'.

fill_blank.text: I was about ___ leave when the ground began to shake.
fill_blank.translation: Би гарах гэж байтал газар хөдөлж эхэлсэн.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Be about to' is followed by the base verb.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Be about to' дараа үйл үгийн анхны хэлбэр орно.

fill_blank.text: We were about to sit down for dinner ___ the tremor hit.
fill_blank.translation: Бид оройн хоолонд суух гэж байтал доргилт болов.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'When' introduces the sudden interruption after 'was about to'.

fill_blank.text: She ___ about to call her mother when the lights went out.
fill_blank.translation: Тэр ээж рүүгээ залгах гэж байтал гэрэл унтарлаа.

dialogue.speaker: Содгэрэл
dialogue.mn: Чи сая мэдэрсэн үү? Газар хөдөллөө!
dialogue.en: Did you feel that just now? The ground shook!
dialogue.mn_latin: Chi saya medersen üü? Gazar khödöllöö!

dialogue.speaker: Майкл
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ! Би хоол хийх гэж байтал шал доргиж эхэлсэн.
dialogue.en: Yes! I was about to cook when the floor started shaking.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee! Bi khool khiikh gej baital shal dorgij ekhelsen.

dialogue.speaker: Содгэрэл
dialogue.mn: Бид ширээний доор нуугдаад, дараа нь шатаар бууж гарцгаая.
dialogue.en: Let's hide under the table, then go down the stairs.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bid shireenii door nuugdaad, daraa ni shataar buuj gartsgaaya.

dialogue.speaker: Содгэрэл
dialogue.en: Right. Did you turn off the gas?

dialogue.speaker: Майкл
dialogue.mn: Тийм. Хананд цууралт ч харагдаж байна.
dialogue.en: Yes. I can even see a crack in the wall.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim. Khanand tsuuralt ch kharagdaj baina.

dialogue.speaker: Содгэрэл
dialogue.mn: Талбай дээр хөршүүдтэйгээ уулзаад давтан доргилтыг хүлээе.
dialogue.en: Let's meet our neighbors in the square and wait out any aftershocks.
dialogue.mn_latin: Talbai deer khörshüüdteigee uulzaad davtan dorgiltyg khüleeye.

dialogue.speaker: Майкл
dialogue.mn: За, явъя. Аюулгүй байх нь хамгийн чухал.
dialogue.en: OK, let's go. Being safe is the most important thing.
dialogue.mn_latin: Za, yavya. Ayuulgüi baikh ni khamgiin chukhal.

culture_note.en: Mongolia is not as famous for earthquakes as Japan, but it does have active fault zones, and tremors have been felt in Ulaanbaatar. Many people live in older Soviet-era apartment blocks or in ger districts, so knowing safe places and evacuation routes matters. Emergency services can be reached by calling 101 (fire), 102 (police), 103 (ambulance) or 105 (emergency management). The National Emergency Management Agency also posts safety advice.
culture_note.mn: Монгол Япон шиг газар хөдлөлтөөрөө алдартай биш ч идэвхтэй хагарлын бүстэй бөгөөд Улаанбаатарт доргилт мэдрэгдэж байсан. Олон хүн хуучин Зөвлөлтийн үеийн орон сууц эсвэл гэр хороололд амьдардаг тул аюулгүй газар, нүүлгэн шилжүүлэх замаа мэддэг байх нь чухал. Яаралтай тусламжид 101 (гал), 102 (цагдаа), 103 (түргэн тусламж), 105 (онцгой байдал) руу залгаж болох ба Онцгой байдлын ерөнхий газар аюулгүй байдлын зөвлөгөө өгдөг.

review.notes: Mostly good, but it has a fake word (нуруулах), an ungrammatical main sentence, an ambiguous fill-in-the-blank, and a few inaccurate or unnatural translations.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed the debris word, a verb converb error, redundant wording, the grammar explanation and the emergency numbers.

changes.why: 'үлдэгдэл' means leftover or balance; building debris is 'нуранги'
the original description of the suffix was inaccurate
'suddenly' is not a connector; added were
the fire number is 101; 105 is emergency management
